meta.title: BTracker: Real-time genomic epidemiology of the Bacillus cereus group
meta.description: ## *Bacillus tropicus* ST78 clade (*B. cereus* group emerging lineage) ### Core-SNP maximum likelihood based phylogeny - **# genomes: 14 (Last Updated: 2026-04-30)** #### Reference Genome (for SNP calling and annotation) - **BTyperDB_ID:** BTDB_2025-0002000.1 - **Strain:** JMT105-2 - **NCBI_BioSample:** SAMN32338359 ### SNP distance summary ##### Pairwise SNP distances (n = 38 genomes | Last Updated: 2026-04-30) ##### Distribution of pairwise SNP distances (n = 38 genomes | Last Updated: 2026-04-30) ### Bioinformatics Workflow **The following workflow was used to build this phylogenomic dataset:** - Gather all *B. tropicus* ST78 clade genomes from BTyperDB based on ANI (should be >99% ANI between any two genomes). - Refer to the BTyperDB pipeline for information about how the genomes were aggregated and annotated with genomic and metadata information. - Choose an appropriate reference genome to call variants (Highest quality genome: preferably most complete or closed genome, without plasmids) - Annotate reference genome using bakta - SNIPPY: - Variant calling per sample and joint variant calling with snippy-core - Remove reference sequence (the duplicate version with plasmids is still in the dataset) - Clean the full length core genome alignment - GUBBINS: - Identify and remove recombinations - Get the full length recombination masked alignment - SNP-SITES: - Query each resulting full length recombination-masked alignment for core SNPs and constant sites - Also output the core SNP alignment in vcf format for augur - IQ-TREE: - Build a maximum likelihood based phylogeny from the recombination-masked core SNP aligment - Midpoint root the phylogeny - BTracker Dataset: - Update the directory for the dataset (build) with the rooted tree, vcf alignment of recombination masked core SNPs and metadata files. - Add reference information (reference sequence fasta, and annotation .gbff file) - AUGUR: - Refine the tree (add branch lengths and produce the relevant tree/node data json) - Infer the ancestral sequence of each internal node and identify any nucleotide mutations on the branches leading to any node in the tree - Identify amino acid mutations from the nucleotide mutations and a reference sequence with gene coordinate annotations - Create a gene list to only extract annotations which have a mutation - Identify amino acid mutations again, but restricting them to this gene list - Annotate the tree (add BTyperDB metadata, geoloc, auspice config and dataset description) and export dataset for Auspice
